note_text: Samsung is the world's largest memory manufacturer. While SK Hynix briefly led in DRAM revenue during 2025, Samsung reclaimed the top position in Q4 2025 with a 36.5% market share compared to SK Hynix’s 32.1% and expanded that lead in early 2026. https://www.trendforce.com/presscenter/news/20260226-12937.html https://www.techtimes.com/articles/318052/20260609/samsung-leads-dram-market-share-386-sk-hynix-trails-revenue-tops-profit-margins.htm
claim: SK Hynix is the largest memory manufacturer.
context: Nvidia is now the largest customer at TSMC and SK Hynix, the largest memory manufacturer.

source_verification.reasoning: The note's claims are: (1) Samsung is the world's largest memory manufacturer; (2) SK Hynix briefly led in DRAM revenue during 2025; (3) Samsung reclaimed top position in Q4 2025 with 36.5% vs SK Hynix 32.1%; (4) expanded that lead in early 2026. The TechTimes source supports claims 1, 2, 4 and the 36.5% Q4 figure. The TrendForce source supports the Q4 reclaim with SK Hynix at 32.1% (Samsung listed at 36%, close to the 36.5% in the note, which the TechTimes source confirms as 36.5%). Both sources together cover every factual claim.

citations.quote: Samsung’s 4Q25 revenue climbed to $19.30 billion, up 43% QoQ, lifting its market share by 3.4 percentage points to 36%, allowing it to reclaim the top position.
citations.explanation: Supports that Samsung reclaimed No. 1 in Q4 2025. Note says 36.5%; this source says 36%.

citations.quote: SK hynix posted revenue of $17.22 billion, up 25.2% QoQ, though its market share slipped 1.1 percentage points to 32.1%, ranking second.
citations.explanation: Supports SK Hynix at 32.1% market share, second place, in Q4 2025.

citations.quote: Samsung led with a 38.6% share, up 2.1 percentage points from 36.5% in the fourth quarter.
citations.explanation: Supports the 36.5% Q4 figure cited in the note and confirms Samsung expanded its lead in early 2026 (Q1 2026 at 38.6%).

citations.quote: Samsung ceded the DRAM crown to SK hynix in the first quarter of 2025 — the first time it had lost the top spot since 1992 — then reclaimed it in the fourth quarter and has extended the lead since.
citations.explanation: Supports that SK Hynix briefly led in 2025 and Samsung reclaimed and extended the lead.

citations.quote: Samsung Electronics led the global DRAM market with a 38.6% revenue share in the first quarter of 2026
citations.explanation: Supports Samsung as largest DRAM maker / world's largest memory manufacturer claim.
